description: The SAME production patch as mvc824-fileattachment-fk-guard-http, checked instead against test/WalkingTec.Mvvm.Admin.Test/FrameworkControllerUpdateModelPropertyPersistTests.cs's UpdateModelProperty_FileAttachmentForeignKey_RejectedButNonAttachmentFieldStillSucceeds, which calls _FrameworkController.UpdateModelProperty directly against a real BaseCRUDVM (FrameworkUserVM) and a real seeded FrameworkUser + FileAttachment pair.
